2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series introduces a new zonelist type, ZONELIST_PRIVATE, which is used for private-node access in the page allocator. The private node has its own local zones, and this zonelist is used to restrict allocations to that single node. This change aims to limit complexity by avoiding fallback behavior to common nodes when the private node is out of memory.
